chapter_title: Concerning Food: It shall be allocated to Five Pro

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
All the instruction, affection, and knowledge that a person receives and makes their own within life is taken into the inner human and, from that appropriation, is set in order into a sufficient series of outflowing effects.

The first effect is an outflow that arises when the person is lifted above the ordinary state into interior perception, and it ascends into the ruling understanding. It then diffuses through all the powers of life in the whole person, and its extension cannot be measured because it reaches as far as the person’s reception allows.

The second effect is an outflow that comes forth as communicated truth, when what is within passes into expressed meaning and ordered utterance.

The third effect is an outflow that becomes actual power for use, when inward intention passes into vigor, execution, and accomplished works.

The fourth effect is an outflow generated from merely natural delight separated from higher love, when the will is kindled by impure pleasure and seeks conjunction on that level.

The fifth effect is an outflow fixed in the outermost degree as a new formed life in the natural plane, brought into determinate existence from its origins. This is life in the lowest level, and only those who were the immediate source of it distinctly acknowledge it as theirs. They attend to its tendencies, its thinking, and its love continually, without ceasing; yet the other four effects they do not perceive and do not care for, because these do not appear outwardly in the senses.

paragraph_translations.translation: All the instruction, affection, and knowledge that a person receives and makes part of life, entering into the whole of their outward conduct, is to be arranged and brought forth as a sufficient set of five effects.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the topic by stating the general law of how inward appropriation becomes ordered outcomes.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Food” required a broad rendering as whatever is taken in and made one’s own; “five productions” treated as a sufficient series of effects.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first effect is an outflow arising when the person is lifted into interior delight and perception, and it ascends into the ruling understanding. It then spreads through every operative power in the person, without measurable limit, because it extends according to reception.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing the first and most interiorly expansive effect.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Rapture” was taken as elevation into interior perception and delight; “Mind” as the ruling understanding; “limbs” as powers for action.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second effect is an outflow that comes forth as expressed meaning and communicated truth, when what is within passes into ordered utterance.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by stating the next outward degree of the outflow.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Voice and word” were condensed into communicated truth in articulated form.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third effect is an outflow that becomes strength for use, when inward intention proceeds into vigor, activity, and accomplished works.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by moving from speech into effective action.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Strength and activity” required a use-oriented phrasing to avoid naturalism while keeping the sense of execution.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth effect is an outflow generated from merely natural delight severed from higher love, when desire is kindled by impure pleasure and seeks conjunction on that level.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS by turning from orderly uses to a lower origin of desire.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source phrase was explicit; translated as natural delight separated from higher love to preserve the spiritual contrast.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fifth effect is an outflow fixed in the outermost degree as a newly formed life in the lowest plane, brought into determinate existence from its origins and proceeding into its own distinct state. Only those who were its immediate source distinctly acknowledge this life as theirs, and they attend unceasingly to its tendencies, its thinking, and its love. Yet the other four effects they do not perceive and do not care for, because these do not present themselves in outward appearance.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing the final, ultimate effect and contrasting it with the unseen interior effects.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Flesh” and “corporeal creature” were rendered as life fixed in the lowest/outermost degree; “parents” as immediate sources; “displayed” as outwardly apparent to the senses.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single teaching on how what is inwardly appropriated is ordered into five outwarding effects across degrees, ending with a contrast between what is sensibly manifest and what remains inward and therefore neglected. The voice is consistent; the only strain is the compressed and ambiguous scope of “food,” which must be taken broadly as all received spiritual nourishment.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential setup: ‘food’ is treated functionally as what is taken in and becomes the body’s substance, then mapped to a fivefold sequence of outcomes (‘productions’). No intrusion of named jurisdictions or governance language.
findings.evidence: Text: “This sustenance … enters the body; it shall be distributed to five productions.” The spiritual reading noted only a scope ambiguity (“Food” required a broad rendering) but did not report a narrative break; the statement still functions as a general law of intake → ordered outflow, which is characteristic substrate teaching by function.

findings.diagnosis: Clean, internally graded functional sequence (interior → expression → execution). The ‘rapture/Mind/limbs’ triad reads as a correspondential anatomy of states and operations rather than an administrative taxonomy.
findings.evidence: Text: “in rapture and rises up in the Mind … comes out from all his limbs …”; then “in voice and word”; then “in strength and activity.” The spiritual reading’s paraphrase tracks a smooth outwarding order (interior perception → speech → works) with no stumbling or forced bridge; nothing here sounds like later governance material (no ranks, authorities, stations, or named powers).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty only in moral ‘shift,’ not a textual intrusion. The fourth item introduces sexual lust as a lower generative mode; this is still functional (a production generated by a specific appetitive cause) and remains inside the chapter’s fivefold production scheme.
findings.evidence: Text: “The fourth is what is engendered by the pleasure of lu[s]t in men and women.” The spiritual reading marked it as a ‘SHIFTS’ moment but did not claim it ‘doesn’t fit’; it remains syntactically parallel to the other products (“The X is…”), and the causality is functional (what this pleasure produces). No administrative markers appear.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential climax and perceptibility-contrast. The fifth production is bodily offspring; the closing contrast (‘only its parents recognize it… the other four forms… not displayed’) functions as a phenomenology of attention: people fixate on the sensibly manifest and neglect interior productions. No evidence of a seam-expansion or overlay block.
findings.evidence: Text: “formed and sculpted in the flesh… corporeal creature… only its parents can recognise… attentive to its desire and its thought and its [lo]ve… However, these other four forms they neither notice… because they are not displayed.” The spiritual reading reports overall coherence and uses this as the chapter’s culminating contrast (seen vs unseen effects). The logic tightens the fivefold scheme rather than derailing it; no named administrators or jurisdiction lists appear.

textual_criticism.summary: No disruptive insertions detected. All paragraphs read in a consistent correspondential (functional) voice: intake (‘food/sustenance’) → five graded productions (interior rapture, speech, action, lust-driven generation, bodily offspring) with a coherent concluding contrast about visibility and human attention. The only noted strain is semantic breadth of ‘food,’ which is a translation/interpretive ambiguity rather than evidence of administrative overlay or seam-expansion. Recommended excisions: 0. Recommended annotations: 0.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: This sustenance of various kinds that people gather in and eat, and enters the body; it shall be distributed to five productions.
The first product is this that shall issue from the person in rapture and rises up in the Mind, and it comes out from all his limbs, and is immeasurable.
The second is this that shall issue from the person in voice and word.
The third is this that shall spring from them in strength and activity.
The fourth is what is engendered by the pleasure of lu[s]t in men and women.

The fifth is this that shall be formed and sculpted in the flesh, and be engendered and come from them. It is this corporeal creature; only its parents can recognise this creature that they beget. They are attentive to its desire and its thought and its [lo]ve every day, all the time. However, these other four forms they neither notice nor are concerned about; because they are not displayed.

changes_summary: No changes made. The critic’s findings for ¶2–¶7 all recommended none (no excisions or annotations), judging the chapter coherent and free of intrusive overlay material.
